about: Host and model prices for cost_estimate. Every price carries the page it was read from and the day it was read. A price that could not be read on the vendor's own page is the text 'see vendor page', never a number. Prices change: read the page again before you rely on one.

posit_connect_course.note: The course server is one fixed cost shared by every team; a team gets no bill. Posit's defaults: MinProcesses 0, IdleTimeout 5s, InitTimeout 120s, MaxProcesses 3, MinProcessesLimit 10; max processes cannot be set to zero.

digitalocean_fixed.note: Shared (Fixed) CPU: one container instance only, 1 vCPU, 512 MiB, autoscaling no. The plan Module 4 uses; it never sleeps.
digitalocean_fixed.quote: Selecting a fixed CPU will limit you to one container instance only

digitalocean_scale_to_zero.note: Private preview as of 2026-11-05: request access through Support; may not be suitable for production; web services only; sleeps after 600 to 86,400 seconds of inactivity; billed at 10 percent of the standard price while at zero; waking typically takes several seconds; cannot be combined with request-based autoscaling. Not used in the estimate.

aws_lambda.note: x86, on-demand, read from the page's worked examples. The INIT (start-up) phase is billed from 2025-08-01 for ZIP functions on managed runtimes.

google_cloud_run.note: Request-based billing, tier 1, active time; free tier based on us-central1. The page has a second, instance-based table with other rates; those are not used here.

fly_io.note: shared-cpu-1x 256MB, billed by the second while a Machine runs ($2.19 per month always on). Stopped Machine rootfs $0.15 per GB; volumes $0.15 per GB per month. Auto stop and start behaviour is not verified. Not used in the estimate.

model.note: Fill this from your own model provider's page, with its URL and the day you read it. Until you do, cost.json counts the model calls and leaves their cost blank.
